Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

==Trivia==
[[Evolution|Green Baby]] can be obtained from [[Evolution|Jio's Bone]] after Killing 12 Sinner's Souls (Bosses from Space Center Map).

* To get [[Evolution|Jio's Bone]], do Infinite Mode on the Space Center Map and you will obtain it.

* Best way to grind Sinner's Souls faster is to do Space Center's infinite mode until wave 50, repeat it 2-3 times and you will have 12 Sinner's Souls.
* All of his upgrade costs are prime numbers, befitting the character's personality.
* Number of Sinners Souls decreased from 36 to 12.
